nodes.label: Logical Queue Names (default, reports, exports, notifications, maintenance)
nodes.norm_label: logical queue names (default, reports, exports, notifications, maintenance)

nodes.label: Caching Without Redis (file/database cache)
nodes.rationale: Cache only low-risk reference data; never a correctness requirement; avoid caching changing financial balances.

nodes.label: Concurrency Locks (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE / lockForUpdate)
nodes.rationale: Used for sequences, limited-serial stock posting, payment allocation and check state moves where a double transition could occur.

nodes.label: Atomic Document Number Sequences
nodes.rationale: Configurable per document type; generation must be atomic under concurrency (row locks).

nodes.label: Excluded: Docker, Redis, PostgreSQL, Multi-company/Multi-branch, E-commerce
nodes.rationale: Scope kept to what serves one physical shop; traditional deployment and MySQL-only infrastructure.
nodes.norm_label: excluded: docker, redis, postgresql, multi-company/multi-branch, e-commerce

nodes.label: Idempotent Job Design
nodes.rationale: Jobs carry IDs not model graphs, refetch data, define tries/backoff/timeout and use afterCommit().

nodes.label: Laravel Queue (database driver)
nodes.rationale: Queue stored in MySQL (QUEUE_CONNECTION=database) because Redis is excluded; suitable for single-store volume, optimize with separate workers/queue names before reconsidering.

nodes.label: Document Counter Locking-Read Fix (updateOrInsert race)
nodes.rationale: MySQL repeatable-read snapshots and Laravel updateOrInsert's non-locking existence check allowed duplicate keys; allocator now updates/inserts from locked row state.

nodes.label: Inventory Movement Types (opening, receipt, sale issue, return, transfer, adjustment, warranty...)
nodes.norm_label: inventory movement types (opening, receipt, sale issue, return, transfer, adjustment, warranty...)

nodes.label: Serial Statuses (in_stock, reserved, sold, returned_pending_inspection, damaged, ...)
nodes.norm_label: serial statuses (in_stock, reserved, sold, returned_pending_inspection, damaged, ...)

nodes.label: Serialized Appliance Flow (receive -> locate -> transfer -> sell -> return -> warranty)
nodes.norm_label: serialized appliance flow (receive -> locate -> transfer -> sell -> return -> warranty)

nodes.label: Stock Count (cycle/full, serial scan, variance approval)
nodes.norm_label: stock count (cycle/full, serial scan, variance approval)

nodes.label: Internal Stock Locations (Showroom, Warehouse, Reserved, Returns, Damaged, Warranty)
nodes.rationale: Locations are not branches and require no branch accounting.
nodes.norm_label: internal stock locations (showroom, warehouse, reserved, returns, damaged, warranty)

nodes.label: Negative Stock Policy (prohibited by default)
nodes.rationale: Serialized products can never be sold without an actual available serial.

nodes.label: Returns Disposition (inspection classification)
nodes.rationale: Customer returns must not automatically go back to sellable stock.

nodes.label: Warranty (store vs supplier/manufacturer)
nodes.rationale: Warranty start/end computed at sale and preserved even if product policy later changes.

nodes.label: Category Model (parent-child hierarchy)
nodes.rationale: Supports hierarchy but avoids unnecessary depth.

nodes.label: First Login Setup Wizard
nodes.rationale: Account pre-exists; ERP detects incomplete setup on first login and redirects to guided wizard.

nodes.label: Wizard Step 2: Locale and Currency (ILS base; ILS/USD/JOD)
nodes.norm_label: wizard step 2: locale and currency (ils base; ils/usd/jod)

nodes.label: Setup Endpoints (store settings, fiscal years, periods lock, sequences)
nodes.norm_label: setup endpoints (store settings, fiscal years, periods lock, sequences)

nodes.label: Wizard Step 8: Opening Financial Balances
nodes.rationale: Migrated receivables/payables/cash/checks must go through controlled opening-balance journals, not ad-hoc edits.

nodes.label: Multi-Currency Posting (ILS base, USD/JOD)
nodes.rationale: Store transaction currency, foreign amount, rate and base amount; never overwrite old rates.

nodes.label: Owner Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Owner KPIs (sales, gross profit, AR/overdue AR, due installments/checks, bounced checks, payables, cash/bank, inventory value, VAT) must each drill down to source data.

nodes.label: Async Report Export Strategy
nodes.rationale: Small reports render interactively; large PDF/Excel/CSV exports run on the database-backed Laravel Queue with status polling. Generated files expire per retention policy while original accounting data never expires.

nodes.label: KPI Drill-down to Source Data
nodes.rationale: Every dashboard KPI must be traceable to its source transactions so totals can be audited and reconciled.

nodes.label: Separated Application Logging
nodes.rationale: Technical logs, audit logs, queue failures and scheduled-task failures are kept separate; passwords, tokens and card data are never logged.

nodes.label: Authentication Controls
nodes.rationale: Laravel default password hashing, rate-limited login/reset, secure SPA session cookies, and session/token revocation on user disable.

nodes.label: Database Backup Policy
nodes.rationale: Nightly automated MySQL backup with daily/weekly/monthly retention tiers, encrypted off-server copy, synchronized attachment backup and failure alerts.

nodes.label: Recovery Objectives (RPO/RTO)
nodes.rationale: Recommended single-store starting target RPO <= 24h from nightly backup; RTO documented and rehearsed.

nodes.label: Backend Policy Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Every sensitive action is authorized on the backend; frontend role checks are never trusted.

nodes.label: Restore Testing
nodes.rationale: A backup is not valid until restoration is tested; periodic restores to non-production verify DB integrity, journal balance, reconciliations, attachments and login.

nodes.label: Attachment Access Control
nodes.rationale: Attachments are downloadable only when the user may view the parent entity; direct public file paths are never exposed.

nodes.label: Success Metrics
nodes.rationale: Owner must be able to trace every dashboard number back to source transactions.

nodes.label: Check Dashboards (due, deposited, bounced, expected cash-flow)
nodes.norm_label: check dashboards (due, deposited, bounced, expected cash-flow)

nodes.label: Check Lifecycle State Machine (Received -> Due -> Deposited -> Under Collection -> Cleared/Bounced)
nodes.norm_label: check lifecycle state machine (received -> due -> deposited -> under collection -> cleared/bounced)

nodes.label: Idempotency for Critical APIs
nodes.rationale: Duplicate submissions of payments, check state changes and postings are dangerous; store request keys and resulting document IDs.

nodes.label: Check Accounting Lifecycle (configurable account mappings)
nodes.rationale: Accountants may credit AR at different moments, so mappings are configurable while lifecycle events stay explicit.

nodes.label: Check Controls (privileged clear/bounce, idempotent, no delete after posting)
nodes.norm_label: check controls (privileged clear/bounce, idempotent, no delete after posting)

nodes.label: Business-Aware Duplicate Check Detection
nodes.rationale: Check number alone is not globally unique; use composite key with bank/account holder.

nodes.label: Decision by Law No. 11 of 2026 (VAT Amendment)
nodes.norm_label: decision by law no. 11 of 2026 (vat amendment)

nodes.label: Decision by Law No. 26 of 2024 (Palestinian VAT)
nodes.norm_label: decision by law no. 26 of 2024 (palestinian vat)

nodes.label: Effective-dated Configurable VAT
nodes.rationale: Because VAT law changes over time, rates/rules/templates are effective-dated and configurable, historical posted invoice tax stays frozen, and VAT reports remain auditable to source.

nodes.label: Task 1.2 - Exact Journal Posting and Reversal
nodes.norm_label: task 1.2 - exact journal posting and reversal

nodes.label: Control Accounts Reject Manual Journals
nodes.rationale: AR, AP, Inventory, VAT and check control accounts normally reject manual lines to prevent subledger/GL divergence.

nodes.label: Currency Handling (ILS base; USD/JOD transactions)
nodes.rationale: Store transaction currency, foreign amount, rate and base amount on every posting; never overwrite old rates.

nodes.label: Idempotency Keys for Critical Writes
nodes.rationale: Payment receipt, check transitions, invoice/return posting accept Idempotency-Key; duplicates return the original result instead of duplicating money/stock movement.

nodes.label: Posted Documents Never Deleted (Reversal/Credit Flows)
nodes.rationale: Posted invoices/entries cannot be hard-deleted or silently edited; corrections use credit note, reversal or approved adjustment with audit reason.

nodes.label: Isolated MySQL 8.4 Test Instance (port 3308)
nodes.rationale: Sustained E: disk I/O pressure slowed tests; disposable test data moved to a separate instance while the active store on 3307 was left untouched.

nodes.label: Reversal as Linked Unique Entry (original stays posted)
nodes.rationale: Originals keep status posted; reversal is derived from a linked unique reversal entry instead of updating the original.
nodes.norm_label: reversal as linked unique entry (original stays posted)

nodes.label: External Notification Adapters (SMS/WhatsApp/Email)
nodes.rationale: External messaging is an optional adapter, not a core assumption; consent, templates and history must be stored before automated customer messaging.

nodes.label: TypeScript Conventions
nodes.rationale: strict mode, no any, centralized API types, decimal-safe money arithmetic (no JS float for authoritative totals), typed permission constants.

nodes.label: notifications Queue
nodes.rationale: Notifications are queued so that failure to send a reminder never rolls back a completed sale, payment or accounting posting.

nodes.label: Decimal Types for Money and Quantities
nodes.rationale: Money and quantities use decimal types, never floating point.
nodes.norm_label: decimal types for money and quantities

nodes.label: Laravel Modular Monolith Architecture
nodes.rationale: Domain boundaries mirror the documentation; avoid over-engineered repositories/interfaces where Eloquent plus explicit Actions/Services suffice.

nodes.label: Laravel Conventions
nodes.rationale: Thin controllers, explicit Action classes for state changes, enums for states, domain events only for secondary effects (not required synchronous accounting), stable machine error codes, no model calls in migrations.

nodes.label: Price Controls (cash, installment, minimum price; discount limits)
nodes.norm_label: price controls (cash, installment, minimum price; discount limits)

nodes.label: Sales Print Templates (invoice, receipt, agreement, credit note, delivery slip)
nodes.norm_label: sales print templates (invoice, receipt, agreement, credit note, delivery slip)

nodes.label: Delivery / Fulfilment Tracking
nodes.rationale: Tracks later delivery and reserved serial without becoming an e-commerce system.

nodes.label: Exchange (return/credit + new sale)
nodes.rationale: No opaque inventory swaps that bypass accounting.

nodes.label: Walk-in Cash Customer
nodes.rationale: Cash sales may use a configured walk-in customer; installment sales require a real customer and credit validation.

nodes.label: HTTP-only LAN; Tailscale / Cloudflare Tunnel for remote access
nodes.rationale: Current setup is unencrypted HTTP suitable only inside the store network; do not open router ports; set SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true with HTTPS.
nodes.norm_label: http-only lan; tailscale / cloudflare tunnel for remote access

nodes.label: queue worker service
nodes.rationale: Consumes default,exports,notifications; the 'reports' queue named in the root README worker list is not consumed by any Docker worker (possible gap).

nodes.label: Queue workers (default; reports,exports; notifications,maintenance)
nodes.rationale: Queue reservation timeout (360s) is above the longest worker timeout; core financial posting stays inside the request transaction rather than on the queue.

nodes.label: Goods Receipt (verify product, qty, serials, condition, location)
nodes.norm_label: goods receipt (verify product, qty, serials, condition, location)

nodes.label: Procurement Flow (PO -> approval -> GR -> invoice -> matching -> AP -> payment)
nodes.norm_label: procurement flow (po -> approval -> gr -> invoice -> matching -> ap -> payment)

nodes.label: Purchasing Controls (price variance, PO approval, duplicate invoice, backdating)
nodes.norm_label: purchasing controls (price variance, po approval, duplicate invoice, backdating)

nodes.label: Supplier Invoice
nodes.rationale: Prevent accidental duplicate supplier invoice numbers per supplier.

nodes.label: Small-Shop Mode (direct GR + invoice without PO)
nodes.norm_label: small-shop mode (direct gr + invoice without po)

nodes.label: Isolated browser test store (API 8199 / UI 5199)
nodes.rationale: Backend and browser suites run sequentially because concurrent MySQL schema rebuilds cause I/O-related browser timeouts; -ResetData only resets the checked browser test database.

nodes.label: Verification workflow (artisan test, pint, npm build/lint)
nodes.norm_label: verification workflow (artisan test, pint, npm build/lint)

nodes.label: React Compiler (not enabled)
nodes.rationale: Not enabled because of its impact on dev and build performance.

nodes.label: Test database name guard (_test suffix)
nodes.rationale: Backend tests refuse to run unless the database name ends in _test; the guard runs before Laravel's migration test hooks so the active store is never touched. Tests use real MySQL migrations, triggers, concurrent processes and workers.

nodes.label: VAT16 demo tax code (16%, display only)
nodes.rationale: Demo value only, not a statement of the legal rate; accountant must review before real operation.
nodes.norm_label: vat16 demo tax code (16%, display only)

nodes.label: Daftar (دفتر) ERP for a single appliance store
nodes.norm_label: daftar (دفتر) erp for a single appliance store

nodes.label: Pre-operation configuration (store identity, fiscal years, tax versions, account mappings)
nodes.rationale: No operational opening balances or live VAT rate are seeded, so these must be configured (and reviewed by an accountant) before operations.
nodes.norm_label: pre-operation configuration (store identity, fiscal years, tax versions, account mappings)

nodes.label: robots.txt (allow all crawlers)
nodes.rationale: Default Laravel scaffold file with an empty Disallow; not tightened for a private ERP.

nodes.label: Backend stock Laravel README
nodes.rationale: Unmodified Laravel skeleton README; project-specific docs live in the root README.

nodes.label: Implementation phase gates (IMPLEMENTATION_PROGRESS.md)
nodes.rationale: ERP is built incrementally through phase gates; unimplemented modules are visibly unavailable. Production release requires every applicable phase gate, reconciliation, restore rehearsal and accountant configuration review.

nodes.label: Same-origin SPA serving with /api and /sanctum proxy
nodes.rationale: Serve frontend dist and proxy /api and /sanctum to Laravel on the same origin, with secure session cookies and HTTPS in production (Sanctum stateful cookie auth).
nodes.norm_label: same-origin spa serving with /api and /sanctum proxy

nodes.label: Azure VM docker-compose.yml (1 GB RAM)
nodes.rationale: Internet -> Caddy (HTTPS) -> Nginx -> Laravel php-fpm. Images are built on the Windows PC and loaded by deploy.ps1 so nothing is built on the small VM.

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml (Daftar Docker stack)
nodes.rationale: Only Nginx is published; settings come from .env (copied from .env.docker.example).

nodes.label: deploy/aws/deploy.sh
nodes.rationale: Pulls from GitHub, builds backend and frontend, applies new migrations, restarts workers; never deletes data. Supports --first-install and --no-pull.

nodes.label: EC2 Amazon Linux 2023 deployment without Docker (Nginx + PHP 8.3-FPM + MySQL 8.4 + Supervisor)
nodes.norm_label: ec2 amazon linux 2023 deployment without docker (nginx + php 8.3-fpm + mysql 8.4 + supervisor)

nodes.label: Private GitHub repo with read-only deploy key
nodes.norm_label: private github repo with read-only deploy key

nodes.label: php artisan erp:create-owner
nodes.rationale: No fixed default password is committed, so the first owner on a new installation is provisioned explicitly after migrations and seeding.

nodes.label: Per-container memory limits for 1 GB VM
nodes.rationale: mem_limit per service (app 400m, workers 300m, scheduler 128m, web 64m, caddy 96m, db 450m) to fit a free-tier 1 GB VM.
nodes.norm_label: per-container memory limits for 1 gb vm

nodes.label: Credit approval for sale exceeding customer limit
nodes.norm_label: credit approval for sale exceeding customer limit

nodes.label: erp_demo_year_2026.sql demo database dump
nodes.rationale: Fully fictitious data Jan to 22 Sep 2026; the file drops and recreates tables, so it must never be imported over real data. Pre-generation backup kept in .runtime/demo-backups/.

nodes.label: php artisan erp:demo-year
nodes.rationale: INSERTs were not hand-written because triggers block direct insertion of posted documents; the command calls the same real system operations as the screens so every entry passes real validations and approvals.

nodes.label: Full purchase cycle (PO, approval, serial receipt, supplier invoice, payment)
nodes.norm_label: full purchase cycle (po, approval, serial receipt, supplier invoice, payment)

nodes.label: Installment policy full_price_at_sale
nodes.rationale: Recognizes the full installment price at sale; an accounting decision belonging to the business owner.

nodes.label: Azure local db service (localdb profile, trimmed MySQL 8.4)
nodes.rationale: Optional, only with --profile localdb; trimmed for a 1 GB machine (performance-schema off, 128M buffer pool, 40 max connections).
nodes.norm_label: azure local db service (localdb profile, trimmed mysql 8.4)

nodes.label: Azure Database for MySQL (recommended managed DB)
nodes.norm_label: azure database for mysql (recommended managed db)

nodes.label: Authorized MariaDB to MySQL migration
nodes.rationale: Existing accounts and passwords preserved; env, schema/data backup, SHA-256 manifest and row/FK verification report kept in ignored .runtime/migration-backups; source MariaDB database preserved.

nodes.label: mysqld --log-bin-trust-function-creators=1
nodes.rationale: The schema protects posted documents with triggers, which MySQL binary logging otherwise refuses to create.

nodes.label: Immutable posted journals (MySQL-level triggers)
nodes.rationale: Posted journals are immutable at the MySQL level; reversals preserve their original currency conversion.

nodes.label: AWS Security Group (22 own IP, 80/443 public)
nodes.norm_label: aws security group (22 own ip, 80/443 public)

nodes.label: Never run docker compose down -v
nodes.rationale: -v permanently deletes the database and image volumes.

nodes.label: Overdue Logic and Aging Buckets
nodes.rationale: Nightly scheduler derives aging buckets/reminders; overdue is collection/risk state and does not mutate accounting.
